title: Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.07051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Its conclusions neither check themselves nor reach the agent. We propose closed-loop evaluation, an evaluation method for deployed agents. It models evaluation as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, and it requires every level's conclusion to trace back to atomic data and to be computed by versioned rules. The method covers four levels of analysis (span, trace, conversation and engagement), measures along a spine of Execution, Substance, Trajectory and Results, treats Conduct as a constraint throughout, and uses Provenance and Adjudication components to certify the evidence and the evaluators. Evaluator agents generated by an Agent Factory carry these components, each with a domain knowledge pack and an adapter harness. Tw

translated_title: 闭环智能体评估：分层度量与自校准
translated_abstract: 当智能体上线后，团队想知道它是否在正常履行职责，而不仅仅是看它是否报错。然而大多数评估是一次性的：跑一次基准测试、看一眼轨迹、给一个单一分数，其结论既无法自我校验，也无法反馈到智能体本身。我们提出闭环评估，一种针对已部署智能体的评估方法。该方法将评估建模为在有偏评级者与受限结果条件下的性能估计问题，并要求每一层级的结论都能追溯到原子数据，且由带版本管理的规则计算得出。该方法涵盖四个分析层级（片段、轨迹、对话与参与），沿执行、实质、过程与结果这一主线进行度量，始终将行为规范作为约束条件，并使用溯源与裁定组件来认证证据与评估者本身。由智能体工厂生成的评估者智能体携带这些组件，每个评估者都配有领域知识包与适配器框架……
tldr: 该论文提出面向已部署智能体的“闭环评估”方法，将评估建模为有偏评级者与受限结果下的性能估计，通过片段/轨迹/对话/参与四层级分析、版本化规则、溯源与裁定组件以及智能体工厂生成的评估者智能体，实现可追溯、可自我校准并能反馈至智能体本身的持续评估体系。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes closed-loop evaluation for deployed agents, modeling assessment as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, with four analysis levels, versioned computation rules, provenance and adjudication components, and evaluator agents from an Agent Factory to enable self-calibrating, traceable feedback that reaches the agent itself.
